newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's June consumer prices down 0.17 percent.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's June consumer prices down 0.17 percent.

text.p: Indonesia's consumer price index (CPI) fell 0.17 percent month-on-month in June, compared with a rise of 0.19 percent in May, a government official said on Wednesday.
The official told Reuters the CPI showed a decline of 0.17 percent in June. The figures will also be announced at a cabinet meeting on Wednesday.
Indonesia posted an inflation rate of 6.47 percent for the 1996 calendar year against 8.64 percent in 1995.
The government has forecast an inflation rate of six percent for the 1997/98 fiscal year starting on April 1.
